I was skeptical on taking this drug from what I have heard in the past. I took 2.5 pills half by half. The day after I had no ambition what so ever. It's been four days and I still am seeing traces of light a couple times a day, stomach hurting, moody, no ambition,troubles with sight, heat and cold flashes, and irritabilty. Just wondering what I would do or what I did wrong that may have caused this. (First time user)
